name: preview-gestures
title: The file preview: stepping between two pictures, and zooming one (A83)
description: Design 6.16 and 5.5: the next picture slides in as the one shown slides out, following the finger on Android and settling on the glide spring; a swipe too short springs back; a double click or a double tap zooms about the point pressed and back; a pinch follows the fingers about the point between them. The note needs two pictures of different shapes, so that a change of size would show. The desktop pastes them; on Android the newest note must already hold two pictures, chosen with its paperclip (docs/ui/motion-check.md, Several files on one note on the emulator).

setup.eval: (() => { const n = S.notes.find(n => !n.deleted && !n.archived && n.files.some(f => f.src || f.thumb)); document.querySelector('#d-list .row[data-id="' + n.id + '"]').click(); return true; })()

movements.name: step-next
movements.description: To the next picture: → on the desktop, a fling to the left on Android.

movements.name: step-back
movements.description: Back to the first picture: ← on the desktop; on Android a slow drag to the right past the middle, held still before it is let go.

movements.name: spring-back
movements.description: A drag too short, held still and let go: the picture springs back, and nothing steps.

movements.name: zoom-in
movements.description: Zoomed in about a point off the picture's centre: a double click on the desktop, two fingers spreading on Android.

movements.name: zoom-out
movements.description: A double click, or a double tap, brings it back to fit.
